description.narrative: Core support is granted for the implementation of the partner's strategy to strengthen the language development and education rights of ethnic minority communities across northern Pakistan. The strategy focuses on expanding community use of mother‑tongue languages through access to poetry, music, and written materials, and by engaging communities directly in documenting, publishing, and revitalizing their indigenous languages. It promotes pro–mother‑tongue education by supporting policy advocacy at provincial levels and equipping primary teachers with skills to teach in local languages. The work also aims to improve children's literacy and their enjoyment of reading in their mother tongue, while contributing to the long‑term economic resilience and sustainability of minority ethnolinguistic communities. A key element of the strategy is building national and local networks of community organizations, academic institutions, and CBOs dedicated to advancing mother‑tongue language development. Interventions include awareness and sensitisation campaigns, policy engagement, adult literacy and writer workshops, teacher trainings, support for mother‑tongue publications and the creation of cultural groups like poetry clubs and music bands.
